sources.period: Derived: Kepler's third law with the sample's semi-major axis 186.905 au and total mass 0.9919 solar masses, 2,565.7 years of 365.25 d. Roberts et al. (2025, arXiv:2509.14321): orbitize! parallel-tempered MCMC on four VLTI/GRAVITY positions (their chosen subset, Table 2), six SPHERE and NaCo positions (Table 3) and the CRIRES+ velocity of the planet relative to the star, -1.87 +/- 0.04 km/s (Zhang et al. 2024), refitted here with tools/objects/hosted-orbits/orbitize-fit.py (src/objects/yses-1-b/source/orbits/). Their stellar-mass and parallax priors are 'centered on the respective catalog values' without widths: 1.00 +/- 0.02 solar masses (Bohn et al. 2020) and the Gaia DR3 parallax 10.612 +/- 0.012 mas are used. The maximum of orbitize!'s posterior (ln L -31.84), refined with Nelder-Mead from many starts.
